snippet.title: Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED - Rengou vs Z.A.F.T. Portable — [ PSP ] — Intro & Gameplay
snippet.description:
Continuing on the proud tradition of Intro & Gameplay, I present to you;

Kidou Senshi Gundam SEED - Rengou vs Z.A.F.T. Portable

Based upon it's PS2 releases of SEED Rengou vs ZAFT, and SEED Destiny Rengou vs ZAFT 2 Plus, Portable is obviously a combination PSP port of both games and it's still great. Now, arguments about SEED vs UC aside, there are some great mecha designs in this game and it features most enjoyable gameplay. Being that this game follows in the traditions of Federation vs Zeon, and Gundam vs Zeta Gundam, this game would further the general gameplay style of those games and unfortunately, turn UC Climax into obscurity with it's more realistic feel in favor of arcade action.

Of the SEED era mobile suits, I love the Providence Gundam, the GOUF Ignited, Saviour, and the fliers like Moebius Zero. So yes, this is a great game even as handheld.

Recommended for sure if you're into some Gundam action!

Remember to leave a Like and a Comment.
